comparison.objective: Fit a wide blanking panel into the correct rack unit; candidate commissions a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-902 tests bimanual panel transport, rack-hole alignment, clip insertion, and seating; candidate tests hex-key alignment, collar tuning, counterholding, and force-limited relocking.
comparison.success_condition: PR-902 requires both ends home at U6 and release for one second, with explicit partial credit; candidate requires two safe cycles and witness-tested setting retention. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Rack insertion and latching test a different dexterous ability from iterative damper adjustment.
